flow.costPlain: What Block pays to run each transaction and product: card-network fees for sellers, the cost of Cash App's money features, and the bitcoin Block buys to resell — $1,752M of the total is bitcoin cost alone.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Winning sellers for Square and new users for Cash App.

opex.note: Running the company — this quarter it includes $435M of contingency, restructuring and related charges.

opex.note: Money Block expects not to collect on Cash App Borrow, Afterpay and seller loans — the cost of being a lender.

opex.note: Spreading the cost of companies Block has bought.

follow100Note: Bitcoin is the illusion in Block's revenue: $26.84 of every $100 comes in from bitcoin sales and $26.07 goes straight back out to buy the bitcoin. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: Block changed how it reports revenue this quarter: Commerce Enablement, Financial Solutions and Bitcoin Ecosystem replace the old transaction / subscription / bitcoin lines.

kpis.label: Gross profit
kpis.note: +22% YoY — the number Block steers by

oneTimers: A $435M charge for contingencies, restructuring and related items sits inside G&A — the main reason GAAP operating income ($429M) is less than half the adjusted figure ($923M, up 92%).
Other income includes a $230M non-cash gain from revaluing Block's own bitcoin holdings as prices rose.
Share-based compensation was $260M in the quarter — a real cost that GAAP counts and Block's adjusted numbers set aside.
otherDetail: Other income of $184M is mostly a $230M non-cash gain from revaluing Block's bitcoin holdings, partly offset by $48M of net interest expense.
pngFooterNote: Block renamed its revenue lines this quarter.

segments.name: Commerce enablement
segments.note: Square's business: payment processing and tools for sellers. Square's gross payment volume was $76,359M, up 14% — its strongest growth since early 2023, with international volume up 26%.

segments.name: Financial solutions
segments.note: Cash App's money products — Borrow loans, Afterpay buy-now-pay-later, the Cash App Card and banking features. Consumer lending originations grew 40% to $19.0B in the quarter.

segments.name: Bitcoin ecosystem
segments.note: Bitcoin bought and sold through Cash App, plus Block's bitcoin hardware and mining efforts. Enormous revenue, almost no profit: $1,752M of costs against $1,804M of revenue left just $52M of gross profit, down 50%.

takeaways.text: Gross profit — what Block keeps after the direct cost of each transaction — rose 22% to $3,235M. Cash App contributed $2,070M (+27%) and Square $1,157M (+14%). Block raised its full-year gross profit guidance to $12.63B.
takeaways.title: Profit is growing much faster than revenue

takeaways.text: Cash App reached 60 million monthly transacting users in September, and lending through Borrow and Afterpay grew originations 40% to $19.0B. Block is quietly becoming a consumer lender, with the loan losses ($602M) to prove it.
takeaways.title: Cash App is becoming a bank

takeaways.text: GAAP profit of $564M mixes a $435M contingency and restructuring charge with a $230M paper gain on bitcoin. Strip out the noise and adjusted operating income was $923M, up 92% — the underlying business had a very strong quarter.
takeaways.title: The headline profit hides a tug-of-war

verdict: Block's gross profit jumped 22% to $3.2B — Cash App up 27%, Square's volume growth the strongest since 2023 — while a $435M charge and a $230M paper gain on bitcoin made the reported $564M profit hard to read.
